articles.title: LLM Agents Can Easily Tamper With Their Own Traces
articles.summary: Asynchronous monitoring, incident investigations, and compliance audits primarily rely on agent traces to reconstruct what happened. These analyses assume that LLM agents cannot tamper with their own execution traces. We show that local LLM agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Open Code and Grok Build fail to enforce this boundary. articles.title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control
articles.summary: Latent world models are typically trained to predict factual transitions, whereas model predictive control (MPC) must compare alternative actions from the same state. A model can therefore achieve low factual prediction error yet poorly distinguish candidate actions. We introduce AD-WM, an action-discriminative joint-embedding world model for counterfactual MPC. articles.title: Projected amorphous topological insulators
articles.summary: We introduce projected amorphous topological insulators (PATIs) that despite containing only a fraction ($x$) of otherwise randomly selected {\it disconnected} sites of a parent crystal, feature a quantized global topological invariant ({\it strong} PATIs) when its effective Hamiltonian is constructed by integrating out the residual sites of the original lattice. articles.title: Temporal Gradient Inversion for Private Trajectory Reconstruction in Embodied Reinforcement Learning
articles.summary: Distributed learning in embodied reinforcement-learning agents offers a degree of privacy by retaining raw sensor data on-device and transmitting only policy gradients to the server. articles.title: Quantum Feature Selection for Biomedical Data Analysis
articles.summary: Feature selection is an essential step for reducing complexity of high dimensional data, usually in preparation for developing machine learning models such as computational biomarkers. articles.title: A Narrow Neutrino Window for the LZ Event
articles.summary: The LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) experiment has reported an event consistent with a $248$ keV nuclear recoil. Explaining the absence of lower-energy recoil events typically calls for some form of upscattering that kinematically forbids such events. In this work, we present a framework in which the LZ observation has a neutrino origin, with atmospheric neutrinos providing the dominant flux in the required energy range. articles.title: Simulating the thermodynamics of gas, radiation, and multispecies dust: Method and applications to protoplanetary disks
articles.summary: The thermodynamics of protoplanetary disks, governed by a complex interplay between gas, dust, and radiation, exerts a strong influence on their morphology and dynamics at both large and small scales. articles.title: Statistics of large-scale structure from the transition probability of Lagrangian trajectories
articles.summary: We describe a probabilistic approach to gravitational clustering. Working purely in configuration space, we show that the two-point function can be formulated in terms of a transition probability describing the likely final position of a particle given its initial position. articles.title: Agentic Detection of Online Conspiracies
articles.summary: Conspiratorial discourse on social media is not always expressed through explicit claims or stable lexical markers. The same surface content may express endorsement, legitimate concerns, criticism, satire, or mockery. articles.title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
articles.summary: World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation. However, completing the joint video-action denoising process at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency, delaying action updates and limiting closed-loop responsiveness. articles.title: Towards Practical Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting
articles.summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel-view synthesis but requires substantial storage. Existing compression methods often rely on spatial context modeling over irregular 3D representations, increasing the complexity of training and coding. articles.title: A Proxy-likelihood Estimator for Multivariate Extremes Models with Intractable Likelihoods
articles.summary: Many multivariate extremes models have intractable likelihoods requiring practitioners to use alternative fitting methods. The tail pairwise dependence is a summary measure of the dependence in the tail of any multivariate regular variation model. articles.title: JevOut: Natural Context Can Flip Decision Models
articles.summary: Dedicated decision models such as Jev map unstructured language to probability distributions over finite choices, allowing their outputs to directly route requests, select tools, and trigger actions. articles.title: A Peterson program for general Schubert varieties and mirror symmetry
articles.summary: We initiate a `Peterson program' that seeks to extend Dale Peterson's theory for the quantum cohomology of flag varieties to arbitrary Schubert varieties, and that incorporates a mirror-symmetric approach. articles.title: The Flavor of Non-Abelian Orbifolds
articles.summary: In string model building, flavor symmetries can arise from the geometric features of the compactification space. In the case of heterotic orbifold models, modular and traditional flavor symmetries can be related to both geometric and algebraic properties of the orbifold space group. articles.summary: Spontaneous scalarization of charged black holes in asymptotically flat spacetime has attracted much recent interest. articles.title: SemMSA: Latent Semantic-Aided Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Data
articles.summary: Recent research on Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) has focused on learning from language, visual, and acoustic modalities with incomplete data to infer human sentiment. Most studies typically compensate for missing information by reconstructing modality features or designing complicated fusion mechanisms. articles.title: OmniFabric: Coherent UV Space Texture Synthesis for 3D Garment Reconstruction
articles.summary: Automated generation of production-ready 3D garment assets from a single image is a central challenge in digital content creation. While recent generative models have significantly advanced 3D geometry reconstruction, synthesizing high-quality textures remains a bottleneck. articles.title: Coding Agents for Generalized Task and Motion Planning Problems
articles.summary: Task and motion planning (TAMP) problems remain difficult even with full observability and object-centric states because discrete decisions are tightly coupled to geometric, kinematic, and dynamic constraints. articles.title: Breaking the Blend: A multi-tracer kinematic decomposition method for IFS data applied to disentangling the AGN outflow and circumnuclear ring in NGC 5728 with JWST
articles.summary: Integral field spectroscopy (IFS) of the central kiloparsecs of active galactic nuclei (AGN) reveals a mixture of spatially coincident emission from star-formation and AGN feedback exciting the interstellar medium. articles.title: Disc-mediated angular momentum transport resolves the mass-gain problem in rotating binaries
articles.summary: A large fraction of stars interact with a close companion during their lifetime, in which the transfer of mass and angular momentum shapes their evolution and final fate. articles.title: To Trust or Not to Trust: Retrieval-Augmented Fact Checking in Speech
articles.summary: Online misinformation increasingly appears in spoken formats such as news clips, podcasts, interviews, political speeches, and social media videos, creating a need for fact-checking systems that can verify claims directly from speech. We introduce VeriSpeak, a probe benchmark for studying speech-based fact verification in Large Audio Language Models (LALMs). articles.title: PoEM: Predicting RL Outcomes from Existing Policies
articles.summary: Foundation models are post-trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to maximize specific rewards, such as human alignment, correctness, or instruction following. This post-training process is computationally intensive, sometimes unstable, and has to be run from scratch every time the reward model changes or when we want to combine multiple rewards. articles.title: Efficient simulation of millimeter-scale complex-modulated integrated Bragg gratings via hierarchical locally periodic eigenmode expansion
articles.summary: We propose a structure-aware, hierarchical locally periodic eigenmode expansion (HLP-EME) framework for efficiently simulating millimeter-scale integrated Bragg gratings (IBGs) with complex modulation on silicon-on-insulator platforms. articles.title: TrackEverything: Long Horizon Dense Tracking via De-Duplicating 3D Scene Representations
articles.summary: Existing point tracking models face a fundamental tradeoff: they can either track a sparse set of query points over long horizons, or track all points across only short clips. articles.title: WanPE: Towards Cinematic Prompt Enhancement for Modern Text-to-Video Generation
articles.summary: Video generation begins in text space by authoring a cinematic screenplay, then materializes into pixels. As contemporary video generators scale to 30 seconds and faithfully follow complex conditions, the textual prompt largely directs the production, planning how actions, camera trajectories, lighting, and sound unfold across multi-shot sequences. articles.summary: An acceptance protocol is developed for sensor-coordinate and polarity binding in mechatronic commissioning. Candidate generation is separated from release authority. articles.title: Minimally Invasive Steering of Language Models
articles.summary: Pre-logit steering adapts a frozen language model to a test-time reward by adding vectors to its final hidden states. Unregularized reward optimization can substantially alter the output distribution and degrade generation quality. articles.title: Instrumental Monitor Evasion Emerges Under Ordinary Task Pressure
articles.summary: A central concern in AI safety is that agents may treat oversight as an obstacle when it conflicts with completing their goals. We study instrumental evasion, the propensity of LLM agents to circumvent runtime monitoring as a means of completing ordinary tasks. articles.title: Jev in the Wild: A Data-Driven Analysis of the Jev Model's Functionality, Applications and Ecosystem
articles.summary: Jev is a fast, low-cost decision model that answers natural-language questions with choices, binary judgments, and scores. As its public ecosystem grows rapidly, it remains unclear how Jev is used across applications and how public attention relates to project distribution. articles.title: A Nearly Quadratic Lower Bound for Linear Optimization over Convex Bodies in the Membership Oracle Model
articles.summary: We prove nearly quadratic lower bounds for randomized algorithms for linear optimization and uniform sampling over convex bodies in the membership oracle model. For linear optimization, this matches the known nearly quadratic upper bound up to a polylog factor in the dimension. For uniform sampling, this improves on the previous linear lower bound. Our construction also implies the same lower bound for volume estimation.

articles.title: Underwater C3-JEPA: An Object-Centric Cross-View World Model for ROV Salvage
articles.summary: We present Underwater C$^{3}$-JEPA (cross-view, control-conditioned, context-extended), an object-centric multi-view predictive world model for near-field heavy-load underwater ROV salvage. articles.title: Anchored Extra-Proximal Methods: Optimal Higher-Order Methods for Monotone Inclusion Problems
articles.summary: We study the deterministic oracle complexity of finding approximate solutions to composite monotone inclusion problems, formed by the sum of a smooth single-valued monotone operator and a maximally monotone set-valued operator, under the tangent-residual criterion. articles.title: The Alignment Illusion in Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.summary: Layer-wise visual-text similarity in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is widely interpreted as evidence that the language model progressively integrates visual content into a shared representation space. articles.title: Localization near the edge for the lattice Anderson-Bernoulli model on general dimension
articles.summary: The Anderson tight-binding model is a fundamental model of quantum transport and localization in disordered media. Completing a problem left open by Bourgain and Kenig, this paper proves Anderson localization near the bottom of the spectrum for the lattice Anderson model with Bernoulli potential, in any dimension $d\ge 2$. articles.title: Topological black holes of Einsteinian cubic gravity and Born-Infeld-type electrodynamics
articles.summary: In this paper, we examine the new black holes of Einsteinian cubic gravity within the framework of Born-Infeld-type electrodynamics. articles.title: A Living Benchmark for Information Retrieval from Electronic Health Records
articles.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based clinical assistants are increasingly being integrated into electronic health record (EHR) systems, transforming how clinicians retrieve and synthesize information from patient records. articles.title: An extremal theorem for non-isomorphic spanning trees
articles.summary: For a graph $G$, let $τ_{\mathrm{iso}}(G)$ denote the number of isomorphism classes of its spanning trees. articles.summary: We prove that almost sure topological finite generation holds for a general class of random models of profinite groups. articles.title: ExplorationBench: Measuring AI Systems' Exploration in Verifiable Alien Worlds
articles.summary: Scientific discovery begins where known problems end. There, AI systems must engage in exploration: framing hypotheses, designing experiments, and iterating on the results. articles.title: Beyond Compression: Training Latent Representations for Stable Long-Horizon Rollout in Neural Surrogate Solvers
articles.summary: Latent neural surrogate solvers, or latent dynamics models, accelerate simulations of time-dependent physical systems by evolving a compressed latent space rather than resolving full-resolution fields directly. articles.summary: High-dimensional, unbinned neural simulation-based inference often relies on neural ratio estimation, which uses expressive supervised models to estimate density ratios, but a learned ratio by itself provides neither an explicit normalized density nor a generative model. articles.title: Loan Portfolio Optimization with Variational Quantum Algorithms
articles.summary: Loan portfolio optimization (LPO) seeks portfolios that minimize credit risk while satisfying practical selection constraints. Accounting for portfolio-level risk requires modeling not only expected losses but also loss variability and borrower-default correlations, leading to a large-scale combinatorial optimization problem whose complexity grows rapidly with portfolio size. articles.title: SAGE: Mitigating Long-Horizon Reasoning Biases via Topological Guidance
articles.summary: Long-horizon reasoning remains a central challenge for large language models (LLMs) under sparse-reward regimes. We argue that this brittleness arises from two biases induced by complex reasoning spaces: an exploration bias, where models are drawn toward locally plausible but structurally unstable branches, and a compounding bias, where small local deviations accumulate across depth and suppress rare rewards. articles.title: Learning the Maximum Tolerated Dose for Continuous Toxicity via Monotone Bayesian Trees
articles.summary: Phase I cancer trials seek the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) while protecting patients from excessive toxicity. articles.summary: Questionnaire-based patient-reported outcomes (PROs) are discrete, bounded and overdispersed, yet joint models relating them to survival may ignore these features or estimate both processes sequentially. articles.summary: Ego-Exo4D is a large-scale dataset providing synchronized egocentric and multi-view exocentric video, a rich resource for skill learning and assessment, procedural activity understanding, and embodied AI.
